classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume reads each index file once per unit under `if budget_ns and probe.NS() - started > budget_ns: return staged, True`, abandoning remaining reads when the broadcast producer-time budget expires, while every other rank is held at the trailing `barrier.wait()` until the consumer finishes.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops `for _pass in range(STATISTICS_READS)` re-reading each statistics file 8 times with no budget/time check, and this synchronous read work sits before the per-unit `barrier.wait()` that pins all other ranks.
